recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中央一顆大型漿細胞，核圓偏心、旁邊有淡染核周區，細胞質濃厚紫紅色、邊緣呈不規則毛邊狀，即「火焰細胞」（flame cell），常見於 IgA 型漿細胞增生；C 圖切片 IHC 呈瀰漫陽性。
features: Large plasma cells with abundant, intensely stained reddish-purple (fuchsinophilic) cytoplasm
Ragged, frayed cytoplasmic margins producing a flame-like outline
Round, eccentric nucleus with clumped chromatin and a paler perinuclear zone
Occasional plasma cell with conventional deep-blue cytoplasm (panel A, lower)
Blood-rich aspirate background with crowded red cells and scattered granulocytes
Panel C: marrow biopsy immunostain with widespread positive (brown) cells among fat spaces; antibody not labeled
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows scattered plasma cells, some with abundant, deeply fuchsinophilic cytoplasm with frayed, flame-shaped margins and round eccentric nuclei with clumped chromatin (flame cells); a plasma cell with conventional basophilic cytoplasm is also present. The background is blood-rich with crowded red cells and granulocytes. A corresponding biopsy immunostain (antibody not specified in the figure) shows abundant positive cells among adipocytes. Flame cells reflect accumulated glycoprotein-rich immunoglobulin, classically IgA; in this context the findings are consistent with a plasma cell proliferation producing IgA, and distinction between MGUS and myeloma requires clonal plasma cell quantitation and clinical criteria.

ddx.vs: Same flame-cell morphology; separated from MGUS by ≥10% clonal marrow plasma cells or myeloma-defining events, not by the cytology of individual cells.
Polytypic plasma cells on kappa/lambda staining without an M-protein; flame cells are uncommon and plasma cells are usually perivascular and mature.

ddx.dx: Mott cells / Russell body-containing plasma cells
ddx.vs: Show discrete round globular inclusions (grape-like) rather than diffuse red cytoplasm with frayed edges.
Contains a mixed population of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid lymphocytes and mast cells with MYD88 L265P, rather than isolated flame-type plasma cells.
